description: The Vilano BMX bike is an ideal bike for beginning riders with wide tires for comfortable riding, and training wheels for stability.The Vilano BMX bike is an ideal bike for beginning riders with wide tires for comfortable riding, and training wheels for stability. The fully enclosed chain guard protects young riders. This adorable BMX style bike’s durable hi-ten steel construction exceeds CPSC standards, with a handlebar pad and bell for added safety. The Vilano BMX style bike has an adjustable seat and handlebar for best fit, designed to grow with the child. Fun details include a water bottle holder with water bottle. This great kid’s learning bike comes with coaster (pedal) brakes, and a learning hand brake too. The Vilano BMX bike is perfect for children who are ready to ride on two wheels, just remove the training wheels when they are ready.
